items.caption: Think you've got what it takes to dominate trivia night? Join EWB, SWE, MSE, ASME, IISE, EES, and D90 for Oldfields Trivia Night TONIGHT! Grab some friends, build your team, and put your random knowledge to the test! Friday, September 4th 5-9 PM | Trivia starts at 6 PM SHARP Oldfields - 1571 N 4th St, Columbus, OH 43201 All ages welcome!
